keep: The mineral canvas, graphite media housing, square white inspector, restrained dividers and absence of elevated dashboard cards.

review.readiness_note: Sign off at the captured 390px viewport with one non-blocking wrapping improvement. The capture shows the real workflow’s controls and states, but does not prove successful mutations, playback, downloads or navigation. The document-end tab bar is an explicit capture exception, not a regression.

drift.change: At max-width: 599px, stack each upcoming-post row using display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:stretch; gap:12px. Give the metadata block width:100% and min-width:0. Place Open Connections below it at width:100% and min-height:44px, retaining the existing 8px radius and 14/20px metadata. Leave the desktop row unchanged.
drift.why: The side-by-side recovery button consumes nearly half the phone row, forcing the failure and timestamp into a narrow multiline column and leaving the title separator stranded. Nothing is clipped, but this is unnecessarily difficult to scan.
drift.where: Upcoming posts — failed Opening the shop. record and Open Connections action.

review.why: The production screen preserves the approved working hierarchy rather than merely borrowing its colors: work is inspected first, the white decision plane follows, and subsequent records remain flat and divided. The approximately 16px phone gutters, compact thumbnail strip, strong Content and section headings, restrained control borders and uncropped main photograph translate the desktop composition convincingly. File approval, post publication and shoot progress remain separately labelled; the failed post has a visible recovery action. No financial amount appears in either workspace, and production introduces no invented earnings or payment claim. The only visible weakness is the desktop-style text/action split retained in the final post row.
review.verdict: Yes—Frame Shift was faithfully transferred at 390px, with real functionality visibly preserved and only a non-blocking post-row wrapping issue.
